claims.statement: For a sequence-frozen DENV translational RNA sensor, all 59 independently sampled genotype/context pairs from the pre-registered equal-serotype cluster distribution D, and four full-length genome sentinels (one per serotype), meet the simultaneous functional thresholds F_ON/F_OFF >= 10, F_ON >= 0.25 F_constitutive, and F_OFF <= 0.05 F_constitutive at 60 minutes in every cell-free reaction point of a pre-registered 3-temperature x 3-magnesium grid. If all 59 independent D draws pass, the exact one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on the D failure probability is 4.95%.
assumptions: The sensor sequence and analysis code are frozen before access to the 59 held-out sequence/context pairs.
D is a precisely documented distribution over phylogenetic-cluster representatives, weighted equally across DENV serotypes; the result does not generalize beyond D.
The condition grid is fixed before candidate results are observed, and constitutive reporter controls remain measurable throughout the grid.
Each context draw is independently sampled from D; assay uncertainty is propagated using independent reaction preparations, not repeated time points.
Target concentration is fixed at the published challenge scale (10^13 copies/reaction); this does not establish clinical limit of detection.
claims.novelty_boundary: Pan-DENV sequence coverage, up-to-three-mismatch tolerance, thermodynamic/structure-aware design, and kinetic effects are prior art. Potential increment is a blinded joint sequence-context by reaction-condition certificate, including full-length genome sentinels; priority is unverified.

costs.runtime: Must be measured with pinned software and hardware; estimate not available.

claims.falsifier: A blinded test context or any full-length serotype genome falls below the pre-registered response threshold in any environmental condition. The decisive first test is the paired 36-nt trigger versus flanked/full-length genomic RNA comparison at the low-magnesium/high-structure corner.
claims.next_gate: Resolve the distribution frame from the primary DENV genome corpus; run a variance-estimating pilot; design and freeze a candidate sequence; confirm the held-out finite panel has not leaked into design; then execute the blinded assay.
